title.narrative: Strengthening National and Regional Capacities for Preventing and Countering Hate Speech and Disinformation in the Horn of Africa

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen national and regional (African Union Commission/AUC and Intergovernmental Authority on Development/IGAD) capacities to prevent and counter hate speech and disinformation in the Horn of Africa (HoA). This, in turn, is aimed at strengthening peacebuilding and social cohesion in the HoA. The overall engagement intervention aims to contribute to the (PSF) Peace and Stabilization Fund priority of developing capacity for conflict prevention, including through countering disinformation.

title.narrative: Monitoring mechanisms and early warning systems of the AUC, IGAD and regional CSOs are strengthened and equipped with tools and protocols to systematically detect, analyse and respond to hate speech and disinformation.

target.value: Prepare a ToR and recruit a consultant to lead a joint mapping study on existing policies, practices, actors and monitoring mechanisms related to hate speech and disinformation in the IGAD region

Commission the consultancy for a joint mapping study on existing policies, practices, actors and monitoring mechanisms related to hate speech and disinformation in the IGAD region. The study will include a gender analysis component.
1 regional workshop convened to review the findings of the joint study which will guide the prioritization of activities and action with an estimated 20-25 participants, of which at least 30% are female. At least 1 session will be dedicated to the gendered dimensions of hate speech and disinformation. Report will also ensure the mainstreaming of gender and other cross-cutting issues.
